Subject: 1:1 to discuss recent performance and how I can support

Hi Alex,

I’d like to schedule a 45-minute 1:1 to discuss recent performance concerns and how I can support you. This is a conversation, not a disciplinary meeting, but I want to be direct so it isn’t a surprise.

Specifically I want to go over:
- Persona V3 integration: due March 15, shipped March 28 (13 days late).
- Evaluation pipeline: due April 1 and still incomplete.
- Code review quality: teammates have raised that some of your reviews on complex PRs are one-line "LGTM" with little feedback.
- Communication: you missed two team standups without notice and have been unresponsive on Teams for stretches of 3+ hours on multiple occasions.

I know you were a top performer last year — you led the Persona V2 launch, mentored two junior engineers, and received an "Exceeds" rating. I recognize things can change and there may be workload, blockers, or personal reasons behind this.

Please come ready to share your perspective on the items above, any blockers or constraints, and ideas for what support would help (re-prioritization, pairing, dedicated focus time, or other). My goal is to understand root causes and agree on a concrete plan with clear success criteria and regular check-ins.

Are you available 45 minutes Wednesday 2:00–2:45pm or Thursday 10:00–10:45am? If not, suggest a time this week that works.

Thanks — I want to help you get back on track.

Best,
[Your Name]
